points.place: 法国北部小镇勒卡托-康布雷西
points.title: 早年生活
points.description: 1869年12月31日，亨利·马蒂斯出生于法国北部小镇勒卡托-康布雷西的一个家庭。他的父亲是谷物商人，母亲是一位画家。马蒂斯最初学习法律，并在巴黎成为一名法庭书记员。1889年，他因阑尾炎手术被迫休养，期间母亲送给他一套绘画工具，这激发了他对艺术的兴趣。这段经历成为他人生的重要转折点，尽管他直到21岁才决定全职从事艺术创作。
points.descriptionEn: Born on December 31, 1869, in Le Cateau-Cambrésis, France, Henri Matisse grew up in a family where his father was a grain merchant and his mother was a painter. Initially studying law, Matisse worked as a court administrator in Paris. In 1889, during a convalescence from appendicitis surgery, his mother gave him art supplies, sparking his interest in painting. This experience became a pivotal moment in his life, though he didn't decide to pursue art full-time until he was 21.

points.title: 艺术求学时期
points.description: 1891年，马蒂斯进入巴黎美术学院学习，师从威廉-阿道夫·布格罗等传统画家。然而，他很快对学院派的保守教学方法感到不满。1898年，他受到印象派画家的影响，开始尝试更自由的绘画风格。这一时期，他结识了安德烈·德兰，两人共同发展出野兽派风格。1905年，马蒂斯与德兰在法国南部科利乌尔创作了一系列色彩鲜艳的作品，标志着野兽派的正式诞生。巴黎时期是马蒂斯艺术风格形成的关键阶段，他从传统绘画转向了更具表现力的色彩运用。
points.descriptionEn: In 1891, Matisse entered the École des Beaux-Arts in Paris, studying under traditional painters like William-Adolphe Bouguereau. However, he soon became dissatisfied with the conservative teaching methods. In 1898, influenced by Impressionist painters, he began experimenting with freer painting styles. During this period, he met André Derain, and together they developed the Fauvist style. In 1905, Matisse and Derain created a series of vibrant works in Collioure, southern France, marking the official birth of Fauvism. The Paris period was crucial for the formation of Matisse's artistic style as he transitioned from traditional painting to more expressive color usage.

points.title: 野兽派巅峰
points.description: 1905年，马蒂斯与德兰在法国南部创作了一系列色彩鲜艳、表现力强的作品，这些作品在当年的秋季沙龙展上引起轰动。评论家路易·沃塞尔将他们称为'野兽'，野兽派由此得名。这一时期，马蒂斯创作了《戴帽子的女人》、《生活的欢乐》等代表作，大胆使用纯色和简化形式，打破了传统绘画的束缚。1908年，他发表《笔记》，阐述了自己的艺术理念，强调色彩和情感的表达而非写实。1917年后，马蒂斯逐渐减少了对野兽派风格的极端运用，开始探索更加平衡和和谐的艺术语言。
points.descriptionEn: In 1905, Matisse and Derain created a series of vibrant, expressive works in southern France that caused a sensation at that year's Salon d'Automne. Critic Louis Vauxcelles dubbed them 'wild beasts,' giving Fauvism its name. During this period, Matisse created masterpieces like 'Woman with a Hat' and 'The Joy of Life,' boldly using pure colors and simplified forms to break free from traditional painting constraints. In 1908, he published 'Notes,' articulating his artistic philosophy that emphasized color and emotional expression over realism. After 1917, Matisse gradually reduced his extreme use of Fauvist style, beginning to explore a more balanced and harmonious artistic language.

points.title: 成熟风格形成
points.description: 1917年起，马蒂斯开始在法国南部尼斯定居，这里的光线与色彩对他的艺术产生了深远影响。这一时期，他的风格逐渐从野兽派的狂野转向更加宁静、和谐的表现形式。他创作了《舞蹈》、《音乐》等大型作品，以及大量描绘室内场景和裸体的作品。1920年代，马蒂斯开始探索线条的表现力，发展出独特的线性风格。1930年代，他受到伊斯兰艺术的影响，开始使用更加装饰性的图案和几何形状。1941年，马蒂斯被诊断出患有癌症，手术后他开始减少绘画，转而探索剪纸艺术，这成为他晚年创作的重要形式。
points.descriptionEn: From 1917, Matisse began living in Nice, southern France, where the light and color profoundly influenced his art. During this period, his style gradually shifted from the wildness of Fauvism to more serene and expressive forms. He created large-scale works like 'The Dance' and 'Music,' as well as numerous paintings depicting interior scenes and nudes. In the 1920s, Matisse began exploring the expressive power of lines, developing a distinctive linear style. In the 1930s, influenced by Islamic art, he started using more decorative patterns and geometric shapes. In 1941, Matisse was diagnosed with cancer, and after surgery, he began reducing his painting activities and turned to exploring paper cutouts, which became an important form of his later work.

points.title: 晚年剪纸艺术
points.description: 1941年，马蒂斯被诊断出患有癌症，手术后他大部分时间卧床，这促使他发展出剪纸艺术这一新的创作形式。他使用剪刀直接在彩色纸上剪出形状，然后由助手拼贴成大型作品。这一时期，他创作了《爵士乐》系列、《蓝色裸体》等著名作品，将色彩与形式简化到极致。1950年，马蒂斯受委托为法国旺斯的小礼拜堂设计装饰，这是他晚年最重要的项目之一。1954年11月3日，马蒂斯在尼斯去世，享年84岁。他的剪纸艺术成为20世纪艺术的重要创新，影响了后来的极简主义和观念艺术。
points.descriptionEn: In 1941, Matisse was diagnosed with cancer, and after surgery, he spent much of his time bedridden, which led him to develop paper cutouts as a new form of artistic expression. He directly shapes with scissors on colored paper, which were then assembled into large compositions by assistants. During this period, he created famous works like the 'Jazz' series and 'Blue Nudes,' reducing color and form to their essentials. In 1950, Matisse was commissioned to design decorations for the Rosary Chapel in Vence, France, one of his most important late projects. On November 3, 1954, Matisse died in Nice at the age of 84. His paper cutouts became a significant innovation in 20th-century art, influencing later minimalist and conceptual art.

supporter.zh: 马蒂斯被艺术史学家誉为现代艺术的大师之一，他的色彩革命彻底改变了20世纪绘画的面貌。支持者认为马蒂斯的艺术代表了人类对自由表达的追求，他的作品超越了形式限制，直接诉诸观者的情感。他的剪纸艺术更是晚年创作的巅峰，展现了艺术家在身体受限情况下的创造力与精神自由。马蒂斯的艺术理念强调'准确的表达'而非'准确的复制'，这一思想影响了后世无数艺术家，成为现代艺术的重要精神遗产。
supporter.en: Matisse is hailed by art historians as one of the masters of modern art, whose color revolution completely transformed the face of 20th-century painting. Supporters believe that Matisse's art represents humanity's pursuit of free expression, with his works transcending formal limitations to directly appeal to the viewer's emotions. His paper cutouts represent the pinnacle of his late work, demonstrating the artist's creativity and spiritual freedom under physical constraints. Matisse's artistic philosophy emphasized 'expressive accuracy' rather than 'literal reproduction,' an idea that has influenced countless artists and become an important spiritual legacy of modern art.

critic.zh: 批评者认为马蒂斯的艺术过于简化，缺乏深度和复杂性。一些评论家指责他的野兽派风格是对传统艺术的背叛，认为其色彩运用过于随意，缺乏严谨的结构。此外，马蒂斯在二战期间留在法国继续创作，被一些人批评为与维希政权的妥协。他的晚期剪纸艺术也被部分评论家视为艺术创作的退步，认为这是艺术家创造力衰退的表现。这些批评反映了艺术界对马蒂斯作品的持续争议，以及对其艺术价值和历史定位的不同解读。
critic.en: Critics argue that Matisse's art is overly simplified, lacking depth and complexity. Some commentators accuse his Fauvist style of being a betrayal of traditional art, claiming his use of color is too arbitrary and lacks rigorous structure. Additionally, Matisse's decision to remain in France and continue creating during WWII has been criticized by some as a compromise with the Vichy regime. His late paper cutouts have also been viewed by some critics as a regression in artistic creation, seen as a sign of the artist's declining creativity. These criticisms reflect the ongoing controversy surrounding Matisse's work and different interpretations of his artistic value and historical position.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，马蒂斯被定义为现代艺术的关键人物和色彩大师。他的艺术生涯展现了从传统到现代的完整转变过程，成为艺术史研究的重要案例。马蒂斯的作品被全球各大博物馆收藏，成为艺术教育的经典教材。在流行文化中，他的名字已成为艺术创新的代名词，他的作品被广泛用于广告、时尚和设计领域。马蒂斯的艺术理念'色彩应该像炸药一样使用'已成为艺术史上的名言，影响了一代又一代艺术家。他的生平和作品被多次拍摄成纪录片，成为艺术爱好者了解现代艺术发展的重要窗口。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Matisse is defined as a key figure in modern art and a master of color. His artistic career represents a complete transformation from traditional to modern art, becoming an important case study in art history. Matisse's works are collected by major museums worldwide and serve as classic materials in art education. In popular culture, his name has become synonymous with artistic innovation, and his works are widely used in advertising, fashion, and design. His artistic philosophy that 'color should be used like dynamite' has become a famous quote in art history, influencing generations of artists. His life and works have been adapted into documentaries multiple times, becoming an important window for art enthusiasts to understand the development of modern art.

self.zh: 我梦想着一种平衡、纯粹、宁静的艺术，这种艺术对精神疲惫的人就像一把舒适的安乐椅。
self.en: I dream of an art of balance, of purity and serenity, devoid of troubling or depressing subject matter, which might be for the nervous the equivalent of a good armchair.

others.zh: 马蒂斯是色彩的大师，他教会我们如何用眼睛去感受，而不是用头脑去分析。
others.en: Matisse was a master of color, he taught us how to see with our eyes rather than analyze with our minds.
